outcome: The Templates tab on Setup lists each document template and uploads a new version of one
acceptance_criteria: **Desktop fidelity.** `SCR-34-desktop` passes at `--width 1440`: `report.json` has `pass: true`, `scores.coverageWithExceptions` = 100, `scores.visual` >= 90. — verify: the command, exit 0.

**Phone fidelity.** `SCR-34-mobile` passes at `--width 390` with the `psl_mock_templates=mobile` cookie, same thresholds. `round-<N>/fidelity/scores.txt` lists both boards with coverage, visual and pass. — verify: same command shape; rows in `scores.txt`.

**Exceptions are limited and explained.** Each entry of `fidelity-exceptions.json` has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason`, `approved_by` (`"builder proposal, pending design engineer"` until confirmed) and falls under a Conflicts item below. No entry covers a value the contract can supply. Frame exceptions (top bar persona text, Start work, More ways to start, the tab role) follow `delivery/features/F-11/fidelity-exceptions.json`. — verify: file content; build.md maps entries to Conflicts numbers.

**List from the API only.** On the desktop scenario the page shows the eight names and lines from E-TEMPLATES in the order returned, each with a "TEST TEMPLATE" tag; reordering the fixture reorders the page; a name not in the fixture appears nowhere. `kind`, `updated_by`, `updated_at` and `versions` show only on rows that return them and leave no empty element on rows that do not. — verify: component test on `desktop.json` and a variant with the optional fields removed (text absent from the DOM).

**Badge and copy follow `test_template`.** With every row `true` and no `next_cursor`, the banner and the phone line (with the correct count) show. With one row `false`, the banner and the "All n" line are absent, that row has no test tag and no text claiming it is PSL's own, and the others keep the tag. With `next_cursor` the banner is absent and the count reads "SHOWN". Nothing in `frontend/src` sets or defaults `test_template` to `false`. — verify: component tests on the three data shapes; `grep -rn "test_template" frontend/src/features/setup` shows reads only (no assignment to `false`).

**Upload gating.** The "Upload PSL's version" button exists only on rows with `template_id` and `can_upload === true`. On `readonly.json` no row has one, and the template with no `template_id` has no control and no placeholder, no disabled button. Persona `pm` or `none` gets the not-open view and no template call after the first 403. — verify: component tests; Playwright reads the buttons by role.

**Upload request.** With a chosen file and note, the POST goes to `/api/v1/setup/templates/{template_id}/versions` with the CSRF header and a body of exactly `expected_revision` (the row's `revision`, including `0`), `filename`, `content_base64` (decodes to the file's bytes) and `note`; a blank note is omitted; no other key. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch` asserting header and body, including a revision-0 row and a multi-byte file.

**Success.** On 200 the panel closes, one reload runs, the row shows the new version, "updated by" and day, and the badge exactly as the reload returns it. A stub returning `test_template: false` removes the test tag on that row and shows no extra claim; a stub returning `true` keeps it. Focus lands on the row name and the polite live region announces the new version. If the reload fails the row shows the 200's `version`/`test_template` and the "Uploaded. We couldn’t refresh the list." line. — verify: component tests (both badge values, reload failure); mock test that `versions` and `revision` rise by one.

**Stale (409).** The API message shows, one reload runs, the chosen file and note are cleared, the panel is closed, and the next press cannot send the old file: it sends nothing until the person chooses again, and then carries the reloaded `revision`. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch` (counts asserted); mock `stale` scenario.

**Invalid (422).** The fields named are marked (`aria-invalid`, message tied by `aria-describedby`), the message shows in a `role="alert"` callout, entries are kept, no reload is needed for the next attempt. A note of 2001 characters and a zero-byte file are refused before any request. — verify: component tests; mock `invalid` scenario; fetch count 0 for the client-side refusals.

**Other failures.** 401 shows `SignedOutState` with `next` = `/setup/templates`; 403 and 404 on the read or the write show the not-open view with no template name in the page, tab title or phone bar; a network error or 5xx on the write shows the uncertain notice, reloads once and sends no second POST; if that reload also fails the upload control stays off and Try again only reads. — verify: component tests with `answers` stubs and a recording `fetch`.

**No double submit.** A double press (two clicks in one tick) sends one POST; while uploading the buttons are disabled and a second press sends nothing; opening a second row's panel while the first has a chosen file drops the first selection and sends nothing. — verify: component test with counts.

**Paging.** `Show more` appears only when `next_cursor` is present, sends `cursor` as returned, appends the next rows in order, and on a failed page keeps the shown rows and offers Show more again. After an upload the list reloads from the first page. — verify: component tests on `many.json`; mock test of the cursor.

**Empty and read-only people.** `empty.json` shows the empty state with no banner, count or table. A person whose rows are read-only sees the list and the badges with no upload control and no explanation text invented for it. — verify: component tests.

**Titles and the phone bar.** Desktop: one `h1` (`.setup-title`, computed 34px at 1440). Phone: one `h1` "Templates" (`.setup-phone-title`), the bar link named "Setup" via `useSetupPhoneBack`, and `main` has no back link of its own. The not-open page has one `h1` and no template name. — verify: Playwright reading `getComputedStyle` and the bar link at 1440 and 390.

**Tabs.** The Templates tab has `aria-current="page"`, the other six tabs are unchanged, and no tab shows a badge on this page. Roles, Rules, Costing rule, Delegation, Payroll visibility and Staff accounts still render as before. — verify: component test; `frontend/e2e/setup.spec.ts` passes unchanged.

**The mock matches the contract.** `tests/setup-templates-mock.test.ts` checks: 200 replies validate against the generated schema for both operations; every fixture validates; 401/403/404/409/422 shapes; the check order; the persona rule; a write without CSRF gets 403; the upload bumps `versions` and `revision` and `/__mock/reset` clears it; the mock never returns `test_template: false`. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/setup-templates-mock.test.ts tests/setup-templates*.test.tsx`.

**Accessibility at both widths.** `e2e/setup-templates.spec.ts` shows no axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 390 and 1440 on the list, the upload panel open with a file chosen, the 422 callout, the 409 notice, the empty state and the not-open state; no sideways scroll at 390 (the desktop table's own `overflow-x: auto` wrapper is the board's; the phone shows cards, not the table); visible focus rings; Tab order is tabs, search, then each row's Upload button, and inside an open panel File, Note, Upload version, Cancel; Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its button; 44px targets; the file input has a visible label; the status badge text is not the only signal (the word is in the tag); no animation under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`; the live-region announcements appear. — verify: `cd frontend && E2E_PORT=4641 MOCK_PORT=4642 npx playwright test e2e/setup-templates.spec.ts e2e/setup.spec.ts` with `timezoneId: 'Africa/Lagos'`; output in build.md.

**Tokens only.** `grep -nE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(|hsl\(" frontend/src/features/setup/setup.css` returns nothing new, and no new colour or size appears outside the design-system tokens. — verify: the command and `git diff`.

**Existing behaviour is not weakened.** The existing Setup tests (`tests/setup-*`, `mock/fixtures/setup/*.test.*`) and `e2e/setup.spec.ts` pass unchanged. No removed `expect`, no loosened matcher. `git diff --stat` shows no edit to `frontend/src/shell/**`, `frontend/src/api/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**`, `package.json`, the lock file, or `server.mjs` beyond the additive lines in Lanes. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh` and the diff.

**No new dependency; no hard-coded data.** No new npm package. `grep -rn "Statement of work\|Weekly client report\|Closure report" frontend/src` finds no template name outside tests and fixtures. — verify: the two commands.

**build.md evidence.** build.md contains `scores.txt` for both boards, `side-by-side.png` paths, the exception-to-Conflicts map, every shared-file edit (`SetupFrame.tsx`, `ReservedTab.tsx`, `M1_OPERATIONS`, `server.mjs` dispatch), every mismatch between the types and the boards or the proposal (including the undeclared `cursor` query) for the backend developer, and for each board under 90 the measured gap and cause. — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: Medium. The feature adds one write, a CSRF file upload that supplies the documents later sent to clients, and it depends on a still-proposed backend contract (D-TEMPLATES-VIEW r1 in architecture/model.json:1435). There is no money, identity, migration or authority change, and the 409 and `expected_revision` pattern from F-11 contains the concurrency risk. The `test_template` flag is a business fact the client cares about. The UI must not set it or imply that a test template is PSL's own. Surfaces are `ui`, `api`, `contract-change` (the proposed fields, which gate FE-CONNECT) and `product-decision` (the test-template wording). Product acceptance is required because the flow and copy are new and the client must see them.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
